summary: Backend-only verification of anti-clobber SettingsIn fix + WIB rejection behavior at 00:13/00:31/01:45 using UTC 'Z' ts_device. Created /app/backend/tests/test_settings_partial_and_rejection.py (6 tests) and re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_kiosk_clock.py regression (6 tests). All 11 tests PASSED, 1 skipped (Susiyanto date-specific check). Final DB state verified: settings=01:00/00:00/30/30/Asia/Jakarta, 1 teacher (Susiyanto), 1 attendance (Susiyanto in 00:13 ok late=0). TEMP teachers cleaned up.

minor.issue: Empty-body {} returns 400 'Tidak ada perubahan' — acceptable, but could be treated as no-op 200 to match idempotent PUT semantics.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.SettingsIn is now correctly all-Optional and PUT does $set only sent fields — anti-clobber verified end-to-end (send only {late_tolerance_min:25}; work_start/work_end/early_checkin_min/timezone remain intact).
routes_kiosk._record early-check detail 'too_early:HH:MM:N' verified: at 00:13 WIB with earliest=00:30 → 'too_early:00:30:17' (sisa 17 min).
routes_kiosk._localize correctly converts UTC 'Z' → school tz (Asia/Jakarta): 17:13Z→00:13, 17:31Z→00:31, 18:45Z→01:45.

xdist parallel runner (pytest.ini addopts='-n auto --dist loadscope') races on shared demo school settings between the two test files — recommend keeping serial runs (-o addopts="") when both files are executed together, or refactor to use a per-file school id. Both files individually pass under xdist.
SettingsIn does not validate work_start/work_end format ('HH:MM') at pydantic layer — a bad string would only fail downstream at split(':'); consider regex validator.
faceutil.ahash still uses deprecated Image.getdata (Pillow 14 removal 2027).
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral TEMP teachers (module-scoped) inserted directly into Mongo with unique ahash embeddings; both deleted along with their attendance rows in fixture teardown. Susiyanto teacher & 00:13 attendance not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run both test files SERIALLY to avoid xdist races on shared settings: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_kiosk_clock.py /app/backend/tests/test_settings_partial_and_rejection.py -v -o addopts=""`. BASE=http://localhost:8001 (external URL blocked by Cloudflare for python requests). Expected final settings: 01:00/00:00/30/30/Asia/Jakarta.
rca of the issue: Bug reproduction not needed here (already fixed upstream). Fix validated in two dimensions: (1) partial PUT — sending only {late_tolerance_min:25} keeps early_checkin_min=30 (previously it was clobbered to default 60 because SettingsIn had non-Optional defaults; now all fields Optional[None] and route does $set on model_dump excluding None); (2) rejection semantics — at 00:13 WIB with work_start=01:00 & early_checkin_min=30, earliest=00:30, so 00:13 → HTTP 422 detail 'too_early:00:30:17' (17 min remaining). 00:31 → status=ok late=0. 01:45 → status=late late=15 (tol=30).
